references.text: Same event; shows the progression in Jacob's deception where Isaac repeatedly asks for confirmation before the blessing is completed.
Theological contrast: The false son (Jacob) lies to receive a blessing, while the true Son of God (Jesus) confirms his identity even though it leads to death.
Same event; shows the beginning of the deception where Isaac asks questions before receiving the final deceitful answer in Gen 27:24.
Theological parallel/contrast: Jacob's deceitful confirmation for personal gain versus Jesus' truthful confirmation that leads to crucifixion.
